note: Pre-registered experiments. status: planned | blocked | running | won | killed. Thresholds are assumptions until measured; the weekly brief (python -m faceless marketing) reports each one and never promotes a winner that has not replicated in a different week.

experiments.hypothesis: Source tags and the custom field arrive intact on the first real sales (field prefill documented, aut:F02 confirmed; Ping pass-through weakened, aut:F01).
experiments.metric: Share of the first 3 sales whose src value matches the link sent
experiments.success_threshold: 3 of 3, or 2 of 3 plus the self-report field
experiments.kill_rule: Any miss: fall back to day-level attribution, self-report and Gumroad UTM links; log the limit. No self-purchase or test purchase.

experiments.hypothesis: A cold visitor on the planner page buys at 1.5% or better (assumed; prior 1.5-7% from gum:F19, weakened).
experiments.metric: Purchases divided by unique non-warm tagged product-page views (warm DM clicks excluded; denominator from the owner's weekly Links-table paste, or hub planner-button clicks as an upper bound)
experiments.success_threshold: 3 or more purchases in the first 200 non-warm tagged views
experiments.kill_rule: 0 purchases at 200 views (about 5% chance at a true 1.5%): swap the next pre-approved variant (title and first paragraph, then cover), one change per 7 days. 1-2 at 200: read again at 400. 0-1 at 500 views (about 0.5% chance at 1.5%): checklist-only on all videos and rework positioning with X11. Two failed fixes or an X11 trigger: ask the owner (D3) for the $9 entry-price check. Never change price on this evidence.
experiments.min_sample: 200 non-warm tagged views; BLOCKED as a 30-day test by the feasibility gate (about 40 views a week at base, 5 weeks); runs as a rolling read, first read about Day 40 at base

experiments.hypothesis: At least 5% of people the owner messages personally buy within 7 days (assumed; own:first100 weakened).
experiments.metric: src=dm purchases divided by messages sent
experiments.kill_rule: 0 per 40 after 7 days (about 14% chance at a true 5%): stop messaging more people, no second blast, move hours to creators and Etsy. This stops outreach effort and is not a product verdict; X11 is.

experiments.hypothesis: The hub converts unique visitors to confirmed opt-ins at 1% or better (assumed; the 4% single-opt-in prior from fun:F13 is a 2024 mixed-traffic form average, times 0.26 for confirmation per em:own-12).
experiments.metric: Confirmed opt-ins divided by unique hub visits, by src
experiments.success_threshold: 1% or better at 200 unique hub visits
experiments.kill_rule: Below 0.5% at 500 visits: rewrite promise and button from the owner-approved copy bank (3 Haiku variants, owner picks one). Fewer than 100 visits by Day 14: traffic is the constraint, test no copy. Blocked entirely without a cookieless counter.
experiments.min_sample: 200 unique hub visits; the 500-visit fix trigger is BLOCKED in 30 days (4.8 weeks at base); variants only from the copy bank the owner approved in Days 0-2

experiments.hypothesis: Utility formats (Budget With Me, take-home split, Day N of 365) earn at least 1.5x the 72-hour views of the story and opinion mix; supported by the save-rate gap in mkt:F19 (selected sample, saves are not reach), untested on YouTube.
experiments.metric: Median 72-hour views per video by arm. The day-level hub-visit secondary is dropped because both arms post every day and cannot be separated.
experiments.kill_rule: Utility median at or below control after 20 videos per arm: restore balanced pillar weights. The 35% exploration floor stays throughout.
experiments.min_sample: 20 videos per arm (3 of 5 daily slots utility, 42 vs 28 videos in 14 days); runs

experiments.hypothesis: Owner TikTok planner demos reach 500 median views with a 2% save rate (assumed; floor above the 350 tier mean in fun:F8, below winners in mkt:F19).
experiments.metric: Median views and saves divided by views over the last 14 posts
experiments.success_threshold: Median at least 500 views and saves at least 2%
experiments.kill_rule: Median below 350 after 14 posts: cut to cross-post-only (5 minutes a day or less) and move hours to creators and Etsy. If under 1,000 followers and no Business verification, the CTA points to the YouTube channel page. A missed AI-toggle attestation pauses the trial.

experiments.hypothesis: A Related Video link moves at least 0.3% of the linked Shorts' views to the long-form (assumed; no benchmark exists, fun:F6 confirms only the mechanism).
experiments.metric: (a) Long-form views sourced from linked Shorts divided by linked Shorts' views. (b) Hub visits with src=yt&v=starthere per 100 long-form views, directional only.
experiments.success_threshold: (a) 0.3% or better; (b) at least 1 hub visit per 100 long-form views
experiments.kill_rule: (a) below 0.1% across 30 linked Shorts and 20,000 combined views: stop attaching. (b) the 500-view read is blocked; read at 100 views, then rewrite the first 10 seconds and CTA once and re-measure. Skip if advanced features are not on.
experiments.channel: YouTube Related Video and Start Here long-form
experiments.min_sample: (a) 30 linked Shorts with 20,000 combined views, BLOCKED in 30 days (reads from about Day 55); (b) directional at 100 long-form views. Skip any render with under $0.50 headroom below the $3 ceiling.

experiments.hypothesis: One optimised Etsy listing gets 300 or more visits and 2 or more orders in 28 days from its live date L (assumed; new shop against $1-$10 incumbents, win:f1 to win:f3).
experiments.metric: Etsy views, favorites, orders; net per order after fees
experiments.success_threshold: 300 or more visits and 2 or more orders by L+28
experiments.kill_rule: Fewer than 100 visits at L+14: revise title and tags once. Fewer than 100 visits in the 14 days after the revision (L+28): park Etsy with no further owner hours; the listing stays up at $0.20.
experiments.min_sample: 14 days live for the first read (L+14), 28 days for the full read

experiments.hypothesis: Hand-picked micro-creators accept a free copy plus 40% commission: 3 or more replies and 2 or more posts per 30 pitches (assumed; own:podcast weakened).
experiments.metric: Replies, live posts, attributed sales per live post
experiments.success_threshold: 3 or more replies, 2 or more live posts, 1 or more attributed sale per live post
experiments.kill_rule: No replies after 20 pitches: rewrite once, then stop at 30. Drop any partner whose post makes an income or debt-outcome claim or omits the disclosure.

experiments.hypothesis: Gumroad's Day-5 reminder plus a deliberate ask yields ratings from 10% of buyers (assumed; no-ask baseline about 1.4%, win:f7 weakened; shop-level Etsy ratios 8%+, win:f1 and win:f5).
experiments.metric: Ratings divided by buyers with no connection to the owner
experiments.kill_rule: Below 5% at 20 buyers: the owner may approve a plain follow-up email to opted-in buyers. No agent send. Never reward or ask for positive reviews.
experiments.min_sample: 20 buyers; BLOCKED in 30 days (about 2 buyers a week at base, read about Day 75)

experiments.hypothesis: Jev's hook_strength score rank-correlates with the 72-hour views index; today all 290 logged decisions are heuristic with no outcome labels (rep:F10 weakened).
experiments.metric: Spearman correlation between logged hook_strength and the 72-hour views index, plus precision at the 0.85 floor for hold decisions
experiments.success_threshold: Spearman at least 0.25 on 50 labelled videos (assumed): the question may become an advisory score, still hold-only
experiments.kill_rule: Absolute Spearman below 0.10 at 100 videos: park the question in shadow only. Compliance and fact checks never move to Jev alone.
experiments.min_sample: 50 labelled videos; 100 for the kill read

experiments.hypothesis: Warm contacts want a printable daily planner at $17 more than a spreadsheet or a cheaper product (assumed; the market evidence points toward Sheets at $1-$10: win:f1 to win:f3, mkt:F13 weakened).
experiments.metric: X2 purchases plus format replies the owner counts from the optional printable-versus-spreadsheet line in the warm messages
experiments.success_threshold: 2 or more sales per 40 messages, or at least half of format replies prefer printable
experiments.kill_rule: 0 sales per 40 and 3 or more replies preferring a spreadsheet or a lower price: reopen D3 early (Day 10-14); the agent hands over the Debt spreadsheet draft and the 7-day sample as the second ask, subject to the owner's price approval.
experiments.min_sample: 40 messages; format replies as they arrive
